description: Rename a sales channel or change its displayMode, priceAccess or currency. The key cannot change. Changing the currency abandons the carts open on the channel - check activeCartCount first. Narrowing priceAccess refuses carts and checkout to buyers who no longer qualify; their carts are kept and come back if access returns. Which lists price the channel is changed on the price list (update_price_list channels).

currency.description: Omit to keep it; null or the default currency sells in the default currency, else one of the workspace's additional currencies. A change abandons the channel's open carts (activeCartCount)

displayMode.description: How visitors and customers without a company read the channel's prices: net (VAT added on top) or gross (VAT inside). Default gross; a company buyer keeps their company's mode.

priceAccess.description: Who sees the channel's prices and may buy through it: PUBLIC - anyone (default); MEMBERS - signed-in customers, and registration is open; COMPANY_MEMBERS - buyers of an approved company, the one to use for trade prices. Others get prices withheld and carts refused.

name: update_sales_channel
title: Update sales channel
